historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Fire Department's denial of a permit for an Automobile Parking Station at 1444 Green Street, with conditions on repairs and attendant parking. The present building dates from 1998.
A one-storey garage occupied the site, where a six-storey, 42-unit residential building was proposed. The present building dates from 1998.
The City Planning Commission upheld, 5-0, the negative declaration for a residential building on the garage site, by then 39 dwelling units in seven storeys over one level of parking (Motion 13666).

The City Planning Commission granted conditional-use authorization, 6-1, for a residential building of 39 dwelling units in seven storeys over one level of parking on the lot of more than 10,000 square feet (Motion 13675).
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the department and granted the permit to erect a building with 33 residential condominiums at 1444 Green Street.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the department and granted the permit to demolish a garage at 1444 Green Street. The present building dates from 1998.
